# nrupalakolkar.com

Personal brand site of Nrupal Akolkar, P.Eng. — systems theorist and builder of
trustworthy, verifiable AI tools. 24+ years operating safety-critical energy
infrastructure (CNRL, Shell Canada, L&T, ABB). Guiding principle: the tool
calculates, you decide.

## Pages

- https://nrupalakolkar.com/ — profile: engineering, analytics & strategy, projects, investing, boards & advisory, contact
- https://nrupalakolkar.com/books — Outcome Convergence Systems, his book (feedback, constraints, control); launch-notify signup
- https://nrupalakolkar.com/consulting — AI governance and technology advisory for boards and operators
- https://nrupalakolkar.com/selected-works — project archive: AI, automation, SAP and IT work, 2002–2026
- https://nrupalakolkar.com/credentials — licences, certifications and executive programs, 2009–2023
- https://nrupalakolkar.com/links — every platform: projects, code, research tools, social profiles
- https://nrupalakolkar.com/town — Town AI assistant referral (Milo)
- https://nrupalakolkar.com/hiking — hiking journal (trail reports, gear notes, route logs)
- https://nrupalakolkar.com/photography — landscape and trail photography
